Scope is an audit-and-fix pass: grep all calls, confirm consistency, fix any remaining camelCase props, add inline comment noting the snake_case convention. Low risk change.

title: Champions meta snapshot: push species aggregation into SQL
notes: Route is 118 lines. Move JS-side species GROUP BY aggregation into a SQL GROUP BY query. Reduces payload size and server-side computation. Straightforward refactor with no UI changes. Verify existing tests still pass after SQL restructure.

notes: No og-default.png exists in /public (only icon-192.png, icon-512.png, apple-touch-icon.png). Previous triage (VGC-156, 13-05-26) noted a related partial fix. Generate a 1200x630 static OG image (can use SVG-to-PNG via canvas or a Node script) and wire it into layout.tsx metadata as fallback.
